reviews_captured_by_me.text: I first worked with Guillermo ,owner of GMG Home Solutions LLC, years ago when they installed beautiful Brazilian granite custom counter tops in my kitchen and master bath. I was happy enough to reach out again when I wanted to totally renovate my master bath, but wanted to still use the same granite on a different sized Vanity. Guillermo helped guide us through excellent choices of gorgeous tile and beautiful plumbing fixtures. All of the work was done very efficiently with great detail and care. The cost considering all the services, craftsmanship and sound advice was very reasonable and done on schedule. Any issues were immediately addressed and I couldn’t be happier. I highly recommend this company to help with your remodeling projects.

Guillermo and his team were fantastic to work with from start to finish. He was extremely prompt to talk out the overall job scope. Came out on site same day to gather info and quote and was back the next day to prep for the counter replacement. Full job was completed in roughly 1 week from initial conversation. Highly recommend for your countertop upgrade needs and any other projects they can take on.

Had GMG Home Solutions install a kitchen backsplash for me.They were absolutely wonderful to work with. I went on thumbtack and the owner Guillermo responded within an hour and we set up an appointment to come by the next morning for an estimate. Within an hour of his visit I had a response from his son Guillermo with a very reasonable quote and that they could install the next day. Luis the installer,  and his two other crew members, assisted with prepping, cutting, and cleanup. What an efficient group! I will use them again in a heartbeat. In recent years I have never a such a timely response and such great work ethic and workmanship. Give them a call you won’t be sorry!
